sentences.text: Shri Chetan Joshi, learned counsel for the appellants.

Ms.Priti Keshwani, learned counsel for the respondent [
 ORDER

This miscellaneous appeal under section 173(1) of the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988 is preferred being aggrieved by the award dated 07.11.2023 in MACC No.89/2022 by 3rd Addl. MACT, Khargone for enhancement of Rs.5 lakhs compensation.
2. The sole controversy in this case is calculating the income of Rajendra kumar, who died in a motor vehicle accident on 09.05.2022.
He was working as Forester in the office of Divisional Forest Office, Sendwa.
While calculating the income of the deceased, the provident fund contribution was also deducted and challenging the said deduction, this appeal has been preferred.

3. Perused para-36 of the award along with salary slip issued for NEUTRAL CITATION NO.
2025:MPHC-IND:6519 2 MA-1242-2024 April, 2022 as Ex.A/15, according to which his gross salary was Rs.53,448/- and total deductions were Rs.5,450 in which Rs.5000/- was provident fund,
Rs.250/- was professional tax and Rs.200/- was GIS.
However, the tribunal ought to have deducted only the professional tax of Rs.250/- and the rest of the heads are not deductable.
Thus, the tribunal ought to have taken the net salary as Rs.53,198/- per month.

In view of the above, the compensation is recalculated as under:
Rs.42,13,701/-
Loss of i.e. Rs.53,198x12=6,38,376-27,695 dependency (Tax)=6,10,681+91,602 (15%
FP)=7,02,283 - 2,34,094 (1/3 PE) =4,68,189 x 9 (M)=42,13,701/- Consortium Rs.1,32,000/-

1 (i.e.44000x3) Loss of Rs.16,500/-
estate Funeral Rs.16,500/-
 expenses
Thus, the just and proper amount of compensation in the instant case is Rs.43,78,701/- as against the award of the Tribunal of Rs.39,33,141/-.

Accordingly,
the appellants are entitled to an additional sum of Rs.4,45,560/- over and above the amount which has been awarded by the Tribunal.
5. In the result, the appeal is partly allowed by enhancing the compensation amount by a sum of Rs.4,45,560/-.

The enhanced amount NEUTRAL CITATION NO.
2025:MPHC-IND:6519 3 MA-1242-2024 shall bear interest at the same rate as awarded by the Tribunal.
The other findings recorded by the Tribunal shall remain intact.

(GAJENDRA SINGH) JUDGE hk/
